purpose: Summarize independently screened external island mechanism bridges without converting partial links, source availability, within-system replication, or repeated systems from one archipelago into a formal cross-system causal fit.

systems.strength: direct per-visit/service and reproductive-dependency evidence with floral response, but cross-year/cross-paper linkage
broad island-mainland visitation and direct autofertility plus reproductive-assurance and floral-transition recurrence, but no matched per-visit pollen function

one source-defined two-island system contains floral morph-state divergence, pollinator-environment contrast, single-visit pollen deposition and controlled reproductive dependence, but effectiveness/dependency are not matched on Dong Island
source-locked visitor-class single-visit reproductive outcomes and source-labeled autonomous breeding treatments in the same island study, but no matched floral-response transition

source-native signed bill-flower position predicts pollen-contact and nectar-robbing interaction quality; a closely overlapping contemporary lobelioid-bird study shows frequent robbing and altered nectar replenishment can coexist with high fruit and seed performance, but no same-tagged full chain or controlled reproductive-dependency estimate is available

why_formal_fit_remains_closed: No external system yet supplies all mechanism links at a matched two-sided population/transition unit.
The five systems do not yet supply one compatible mechanism estimand family with source-locked uncertainty across at least two independent clusters.

Nicotiana has cross-year/cross-paper linkage, Caribbean Gesneriaceae lacks matched per-visit pollen function, Cordia lacks Dong-side direct effectiveness and controlled dependency measurements, Seychelles lacks a matched floral-response transition, and Hawaii lobelioids lack a same-tagged full chain plus controlled reproductive dependency.
The Hawaii lobelioid bridge adds a propagation boundary rather than an additional independent geographic replicate beyond Hawaii.
Partial mechanistic recurrence cannot substitute for Issue #91 direct Izu field measurements.
reopen_rule: Reopen external bridge acquisition only when new lawful source-native material can close a named missing link in an existing partial system or provides a candidate matched floral-response, direct effectiveness, and reproductive-dependency transition with compatible uncertainty and hierarchy.
next_decision_gate: Issue #91 first real six-channel field bundle remains the active direct-Izu gate; external bridge work remains source-triggered, while the ABM mechanism line should use admitted partial systems to test propagation boundaries rather than start another unconstrained acquisition loop.
claim_boundary: Five independent biological partial bridge systems strengthen the plausibility and generality of a branching/propagation architecture and reveal alternative mechanisms. They are not five independent geographic strata: the Hawaii lobelioid addition does not create a new geography beyond Hawaii. The registry does not establish a universal island response, universal dependency coefficient, historical pollinator-loss causation, or a formal cross-system causal model.
